title: The hardest pill to swallow today: Most people would rather be comforted by a pleasant lie than confronted by a difficult truth. ⚔️
paragraphs: The hardest pill to swallow today: Most people would rather be comforted by a pleasant lie than confronted by a difficult truth. ⚔️

The Gospel isn't designed to be a warm blanket for your ego; it's a sword meant to cut through the noise. Stepping out of the comfort zone and into reality is a lonely path, but it’s the only one leading to actual freedom.

"For the time will come when people will not put up with sound doctrine. Instead, to suit their own desires, they will gather around them a great number of teachers to say what their itching ears want to hear." — 2 Timothy 4:3
Are you seeking comfort, or are you ready for the truth? 👇
